notes.title: Tower Wars Update! - (German language support!)
notes.notes:
Troops!  There is an exciting new development from the battlegrounds!  Tower Wars now supports German language!  Help us spread the word about our first stop in an effort to bring the game to a more worldwide audience!  If you are one of the many German-speaking Tower Wars fans, be sure to tell your friends that you can now cripple enemy armies and crush enemy castles in your native language!	

Einheiten!  Auf den Schlachtfeldern gibt es eine aufregende Entwicklung!  Tower Wars ist jetzt auch auf Deutsch erhältlich!  Helft uns bei unseren ersten Schritten, das Spiel einem weltweiten Publikum näherzubringen!  Wenn du einer der vielen deutschsprachigen Fans von Tower Wars bist, dann erzähle unbedingt deinen Freunden davon, dass du jetzt auch in deiner Muttersprache feindliche Armeen und Burgen vernichten kannst!

notes.title: Tower Wars Season 3 Update Released
notes.notes:
Tower Wars combines elements of tower defense, RTS, and all-out multi-player mayhem to bring you a completely unique experience, delivered with a fun and funny not-so-old world style!

Along with the third season of competitive play, the latest updates include new ranked maps, gameplay changes, and an extended tutorial. Check it out!

notes.title: Tower Wars Official Season 3 Start + Latest Update Info!!
notes.notes:
[b]INTRODUCING TOWER WARS SEASON 3! [/b]
 
On the heels of our latest update which introduced NEW MAPS to all play modes and many balance changes within the game, today marks the start of Tower Wars Season 3!  Both Season Play and participation is really simple and it doesn't require any special sign-ups or setup.  All you need to do is play the game! From here on out, any time you play a Ranked game, it will count toward the current season! Easy! The more you play, the more you have a chance to climb the Season Leaderboard! 

Of course, there is still a full suite of options for unranked, bot matches and custom game setups all which are playable on the new maps, so no pressure!  We will finalize the end date and reveal prizes soon, so stay tuned! 

For those who might have missed the information on the latest update, check out below!

[b][u]Tower War Update v.1.1133 Information[/u][/b]

[b]New Map[/b]
[list]
[*]We've added a new map for use in ranked/unranked Multiplayer and in Meat vs. Metal -- "Casualty Creek".
[/list]

[b]Maps added to multiplayer dedicated servers[/b]
[list]
[*]Lava You Deeply (reinstated)
[*]Casualty Creek (new)
[/list]

[b]Game balance update[/b]
[u]Units:[/u]
[list]
[*]Increased Zoombot’s BP generation by 10%.
[*]Buffed Mortimer by 10% to health, armor, and shield. Buffed Gold-level Mortimer by 20% to H/A/S.
[*]Reduced gold cost to unlock Mortimer by 10% (leaving BP unlock cost alone).
[*]Reduced gold cost to produce a Mortimer by 10%.
[*]Removed 10% of Mortimers from scripted waves in single-player "tower defense challenges".
[*]Bounties: all tier 3 units and up, gold bounty for killing these units increased to a flat 1/3 of build cost.
[*]Increased berserk response to juggling -- units move faster and stay berserk longer, especially with repeated juggling.
[/list]

[u]Scout Tower:[/u]
[list]
[*]Increased damage boost effect to 15 / 25 / 35%.
[/list]

[u]Lava Tower:[/u]
[list]
[*]Specialized damage to health and armor; now does minimal damage to shields.
[*]Damage-over-time to anyone who walks through, with an extra hit to anyone making a bucket pour.
[*]The net result is expected to be a significant upgrade to the damage output of this tower.
[/list]

[u]Hammer Tower:[/u]
[list]
[*]Increased stun duration to 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds.
[/list]

[u]Level 3 Mines and Miners:[/u]
[list]
[*]Reduced cost of a Level 3 miner to 300 gold, 90 BP.
[*]Increased the gold disadvantage of Bots 1, 2, and 3, to prevent them from benefiting from this change.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Tips added to loading screens.
[*]"Interactive tips" added to bots 1, 2, and 3 -- we chat hints and situational updates to the player.
[*]Bots 1 and 2 made easier (slower progress up the tech tree). They are still allowed to win.
[*]Clicking on a tower no longer upgrades the tower -- use shift-click to upgrade.
[*]Text chat can be disabled.  [i](type /off in the chat window)[/i]
[*]Music volume reduced while in multiplayer queue.
[*]Pre-game "ready" box no longer times out in bot games, so you can go to the fridge during the loading screen.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixs: [/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the elusive random "navmesh" crash.
[*]Fixed invisible ready timer in multiplayer games. Now works as before.
[*]Fixed text chat disable only working for bot tips. Now works for regular chat too.
[*]Fixed high-level bots falsely introducing themselves as low-level bots, promising tips that never happen. Now high-level bots don't chat, as intended.
[*]Fixed a bug in Unranked Private Match: if the host selected Random Map, and it picked Lava Mines or Casualty Creek, then the host would see many missing textures.
[/list]

notes.title: Tower Wars Update (v.1.111)
notes.notes:
[b]Tower Wars Update (v.1.111)[/b]

As Season 1 continues to heat up, update v.1.111 addresses two bugs regarding player scores.  Change list for the update is listed below.

[b]Feature changes:[/b]
[*]Player Scores are no longer being pulled from Steam.  We are now storing Player Scores within our own database to allow for quicker, more accurate reporting.  Note: Win - Loss records are still maintained within Steam.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[*]Fixed Ctrl+Alt+Del Player Score bug
[*]Fixed bug where exiting before match started would sometimes not update player score.
[/list]

notes.title: Tower Wars Update (v.1.110) Official Season 1 Start!!
notes.notes:
[b]INTRODUCING ALL-NEW SEASON PLAY![/b]
 
Today marks the start of Tower Wars Season 1!!  Both Season Play and participation is really simple and it doesn't require any special sign-ups or setup.  All you need to do is play the game! From here on out, any time you play a Ranked game, it will count toward the current season! Easy! The more you play, the more you have a chance to climb the Season Leaderboard! And there are 100 prizes to claim, including 3D-Printed Character Trophies and T-Shirts for the top finishers!
 
Of course, there is still a full suite of options for unranked and custom game setups as well, so no pressure!
 
Season 1 will run for approximately 90 days! We will finalize the end date and reveal prize designs soon, so stay tuned!
 
[b]Patch change list aka "Shiny New Stuff"[/b]
[list]
[*]Season 1 official start!  Ranked games are 1 vs 1.
[*]Season Play wiki.  For all the details check out the wiki page (http://wiki.towerwarsgame.com/index.php?title=Season_Play) OR in-game by navigating to PLAY > RANKED > SEASON INFO.
[*]Season Play Leaderboard (http://leaderboards.towerwarsgame.com/).
[*](In-game) Season Play Leaderboard.  Access the Tower Wars Season Leadersboards by clicking on the new Season Play info box at the top of the Main Menu screen OR by navigating the game menu; PLAY > RANKED > VIEW RANKINGS.
[*]Six new Achievements. (One for pre-Season Play ranking and five for Season Play).
[*]2's and 3's matches are now only playable via Unranked and will not modify your Player Score.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[*]Added a Penalty for queue dodging.
[*]Fixed bugs with Lava Mines level.
[/list]

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!  This is just a quick announcement to let you all know about our next update coming very soon.  There have been some long-requested tweaks that we've been hearing about (for a long time now, I know).  Well I'm happy to annouce a few things are happening around here.

-Increased the timeout length for disconnects to keep you in the game over longer hiccups.

-Players who quit or disconnect will now lose points on their player score.

-Making some requested adjustments in Tiff Cliffs.

-We're resetting the ranked matches leaderboards, but fear not, you will be rewarded for your efforts!  The above changes require that we start fresh.  This is also a bit of a test for something else coming a little later!

Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Tower Wars Product Update
notes.notes:
Introducing the all new co-op mode!
“High above the clouds, there drifts a sad, derelict remnant of a once lively little drifter town... it was ruthlessly attacked by pirates intent on sacking the plump little plum in the sky, but in their greed they sank their own ship under the weight of the first load of plunder! A tempest wind soon thereafter arrived, driving the now un-manned island town far from where it had laid anchor for trade. The inhabitants had hastily fled during the pirate attack, but in so doing left all of their goods, munitions, and rum.... LOTS OF RUM. During one of his many pleasure cruises in his glorious, kingly dirigible, the KING happened to stumble across the abondoned stockpile. He immediately siezed the derelict under his sovereign authority, claiming the rum (and other less important supplies) for his own reserves. BUT!! Providentially, the surviving pirates of the pillaging snaffu had regrouped and showed up just shortly after the KING set up base, and thus found their long-lost gem in the hands of a beligerent, crown-waving baffoon. Having tasted some of the finest rum of the barrels his fat arse now reclined upon, their course of action was clear... This meant WAR!”

Features
-Join up with your friends to protect the rum in the new 1-3 player co-op map, Royal Rum-Bowl!
-Adjust and rebuild your maze after enemy pirates bomb, smash and utterly destroy your towers with randomized enemies and events!
-Compete in 3 new leaderboard for solo, duo and trio scores!
-Enjoy other goodies like a new environment, achievements and music!
"Featuring the new and improved steel plate hex, state-of-the-art craftsmanship of the KING’s own forges! Unfortunately, it has virtually no affect on towers built upon them... it simply has the appearance of being tougher."

Join the fight!

notes.title: Tower Wars Product Update

notes.title: Tower Wars Product Update
notes.notes:
Tower Wars v1.001 Update!

In-Game Stats and Functionality
-Fixed a bug where Mechanized Stature Diminishers were not hitting Zoombots.
-Changed Madam Sudsie’s shield cast on allies from 20/30/40/50 shield/sec to 22/33/44/55 shield/sec and increased how often shields are applied from 2 seconds to 1.25 seconds.
-Fixed a bug where level 1 Ballistic Impulsion Facilitators would track units way too far away.
-Changed Ballistic Impulsion Facilitators stats from 30-60-9 / 38-76-11 / 45-90-14 per hit to 15-60-15 / 19-76-19 / 22.5-90-22.5 (vs health-armor-shield).
-Changed BP gain from units. It was previously a flat bp/s for 30 seconds, then would falloff linearly to 0 over 20 seconds. It now starts 160% higher and drops linearly over 50 seconds. Every unit that survives for 50 seconds will still gain the same BP as before, but it’s gain is now more front loaded.
-Changed Voltaic Liberation Apparatus Damage from 30-30-198 / 32-32-212 / 33-33-218 to 25-25-150 / 25-25-150 / 25-25-150 (vs health-armor-shield). Upgrades now only give you the extra jumps.
-Weak Shield Charge tech corrected. It was 20/40/80 additional shield, but should have been 20/40/60.
-Barracks tech tree stats reduced. All health/armor/shield techs have had their %s reduced, but the additional bonuses go unchanged. Unit speed and BP gain techs also reduced.
-Unit unlock costs changed. The unlock cost curve has changed to be linear. Tier 2 is now more expensive at 250g and 250bp, but end-game units are now cheaper to unlock.
-Reduced the cost of the Equine Subterfuge Transport send from 762g to 400g.
-Baron von Peptos had a recent argument about the best color to wear into battle, red, or blue. Though red is the clear winner here, they could not settle, so they decided to set their machines to no longer heal each other out of spite.


Art/UI
-Reduced the power of wind FX on the fan, particles should blow so far out now.
-Camera shakes added to Mechanized Stature Diminisher attack.
-”Exit Game” renamed to “Surrender” in the in-game menu. This is currently how you give up. A better surrender feature will be added at a later date.
-Added new UI panel, the in-game player list! This new panel shows all players, playerscores, and your team’s current gold and BP. You will have to manually set the hotkey yourself, or reset your hotkeys to default to get it to work. The default hotkey is F5.
-Added a link to our Steam Community group in the main menu. Join us for updates and news about the game!
-Added PlayerScores to Host and Match Setup lobbies.
-Added player card to main menu, showing your PlayerScore, Wins and Losses.


Under the Hood
-Fixed a bug where the camera would start in very wrong places.
